titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, BBC News
mainText: Nicolás Maduro, President of Venezuela, pleaded not guilty to torture-related charges in New York.

titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, BBC News
mainText: A bus collided with a train stopped on the French side of the Channel Tunnel, resulting in 19 people injured.
A shooting occurred at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, resulting in multiple victims; the suspected shooter is dead according to officials.

titleText: JTF News: BBC News, Deutsche Welle
mainText: President Trump cancelled a livestream of an execution by firing squad at Fort Hood.

titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, BBC News
mainText: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine plans to resume strikes on Russian oil refineries.
